memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; manages hotel duties without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative); recalls 3 items, clock draw normal.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal fall risk).
medicines: 0 regular; will initiate therapy for allergic rhinitis, migraine, epilepsy after today.
mood: Reports mild work-related stress; denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I want to stay healthy to manage my hotel and enjoy time with family."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Skin prick test: positive to house dust mite and pollen.
Total serum IgE: 210 IU/mL (reference <100 IU/mL).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent; occasional nasal congestion affecting sleep, but works full shifts.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative); stable.
falls: No falls; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 9 regular; polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria recommended.
mood: Reports improved sleep after nasal spray; denies low mood.
carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I want to keep my symptoms under control so I can focus on work."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal; no epileptiform discharges; no focal slowing.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent; reports occasional migraine breakthrough despite prophylaxis.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative); recalls 2 items, clock draw mild abnormality.
falls: No falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 10 seconds.
medicines: 9 regular; polypharmacy – medication review pending.
mood: Notes frustration with breakthrough headaches; denies depression.
carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I want fewer migraine days to maintain my work performance."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Neurology for evaluation of refractory migraine and optimization of prophylactic regimen.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked with Neurology at Vikram Hospital on 2025-11-05 at 10:30 AM.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Neurology notes: Migraine likely refractory to current prophylaxis; recommends adding CGRP monoclonal antibody and tapering topiramate. EEG normal; continue current epilepsy meds.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent; reports improved migraine control after starting CGRP antibody (added per neurology advice).
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative); stable.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 9 regular; polypharmacy – medication review scheduled for next visit.
mood: Reports better mood, less frustration.
carers: Spouse, Priya.
goals: "I aim to maintain current control and reduce medication burden where possible."
